snippet.title: Gloomy Juncture | Early Uncensored Trailer
snippet.description:
UPDATE: Watch the latest uncensored Official Trailer from Six One Indie Showcase here: https://youtu.be/bfGYIvn9wKY

What starts as a janitor's final task for the day becomes a neo-noir feverish dream.
Gloomy Juncture: A psychological thriller where you're not a hero, just a mundane janitor whose shift collides with the aftermath of a critical gunshot.

Entirely hand-drawn 3D world, fully voice acted, created by one developer and his cat.

Follow and Wishlist:
